Require complete relevant capabilities to enter one continuous reality model

release_7_refinements.change: Distinguish actual state from measurement, inference and unknown state records.
Stable new higher-level structures are one form of cross-scale generation, not a necessary condition for all cross-scale effects.
Language-mediated representation is one analytical path, not a universal cognitive order or a complete empirical theory.

release_7_1_refinements.change: Separate actual temperature from its reading and possible reading error.
Make stopping relative to the requested understanding, research, invention or decision outcome.
Distinguish intervention positions, actions, conditional plans and justified scheduling.
Check rather than assume old behavior functions; conscious endorsement is not required for all behavior.

release_7_4_refinements.change: User explicitly identifies intervention point and leverage point as synonyms. Preserve comparison of their priority without defining separate categories.

release_7_4_3_refinements.change: Prioritize outcome, cost and feasibility under goals and constraints; prefer simpler plans when important conditions are equivalent, rather than minimizing action count as a primary rule.

release_9_8_3_refinements.change: Concentrate the generative relation from present conditions and worthwhile change through actionable entry, lived feedback and updated willingness to habit formation, including environmental entry and threshold shifts.
Compare substantive innovations by causal derivation, consequences and value, including simple high-value changes and mature alternatives.

provenance.release_7_3_method: Complete 7.1/7.2 method retained byte-for-byte, including all nine tables; no private case fixes inserted into the method.

provenance.release_7_4_runtime: Plain public language, purposeful visuals, competing intervention priorities and mapped actions, useful continuation, current-task source boundaries, substantive joint construction and evidence-based ongoing revision. provenance.release_7_4_1_runtime: Clarifies that intervention priorities require prior construction and comparison of feasible actions, with bidirectional refinement; natural user conversation must activate all task-relevant capabilities without method vocabulary, module selection or repeated stage commands. No empirical superiority claim.
provenance.release_7_4_2_runtime: Requires action construction and consequence evaluation in the same turn before delivering intervention points, even when only points are shown or no ranking is requested. Points and actions default to numbered prose, with tables reserved for other appropriate comparisons or explicit user format requests. No new empirical performance claim.
provenance.release_7_4_3_runtime: Ranks interventions and their concrete action alternatives, compares combined and standalone changes before final selection, distinguishes recommendation priority from execution precedence, and performs feedback-driven continuation within the skill. Rules are domain-general; no project-specific solution or empirical superiority claim. Review scope respects point-only presentation. Numeric comparisons of intervention options remain numbered prose, not summary tables.
provenance.release_7_5_method: Complete 7.4.3 method preserved byte-for-byte; no case-specific solution or private evaluation material added.
provenance.release_7_5_runtime: Consolidates core responsibilities and separates internal decision support from current delivery scope. Exploration, evidence and action prototypes co-evolve; genuine additional value is checked without forced novelty. Actions are compared across intervention positions before full planning, including combinations and residual gains. Consequential missing information controls recommendations; users may decline without fabricated certainty. Natural conversation retains explicit plan scope, targeted correction and specific continuation; formatting follows information value. Quality precedes latency, with no implicit quota budget. Text rules and synthetic tests do not establish general superiority or perfect compliance.
provenance.release_7_5_1_runtime: Unifies delivery scope in dialogue: broad change requests first explain and rank intervention positions supported by same-turn feasible-action comparison, then unfold actions through natural continuation. Explicit action, full-plan and execution requests remain directly fulfilled. Complete selectable actions are distinguished from their implementation steps; removal prerequisites and validation scope are explicit. Comparable candidates, combination tradeoffs, targeted correction and substantive task-specific insight are reviewed; development checks include natural prompts without stage cues. The method and state scripts are unchanged. No general superiority, guaranteed novelty or perfect compliance is asserted.
provenance.release_7_5_2_runtime: Defaults substantive open work to quality-first reasoning; activates early information checks and independent domain exploration, then reviews the exact deliverable with actual evidence of candidate/action comparison and issue disposition. Preserves unreported facts as unknown, supports neutral recall, distinguishes formation, activation and maintenance, and carries conditional claims across turns. Broadens meaningful intervention coverage and competing complementary combinations; actively constructs cross-path alternatives and compares new claims to the strongest prior version without manufactured novelty. Plans remain conditional and scope-aware. Method and scripts are unchanged; actual orchestration is tested separately from content-only execution, without any guarantee of general superiority or perfect compliance.
provenance.release_7_5_3_runtime: Consolidates intervention discovery, same-turn implementation comparison, combinations and meaningful candidate retention into shared reviewable results; dialogue is the sole delivery-scope authority. Conditional futures are actually developed; unanswered facts and disconfirmed processes cannot become asserted causes. Continuation follows completed results. The complete method, archived source and executable scripts remain unchanged; no claim of universal compliance or empirical superiority.
provenance.release_7_6_runtime: Reorganizes the entry around actual source loading, early independent work, reviewable task results and exact-output review with explicit delivery scope. Interpretation, construction, implementation comparison and display use the same evolving results; unconfirmed facts retain their status. Explicitly granted complete-task ownership permits bounded delegation. State nodes distinguish supporting premises from recomputation references so unverified hypotheses can remain experiment objects. The complete method and archived specification are preserved; no host enforcement or universal outcome guarantee is claimed.
provenance.release_7_7_runtime: Conclusion-specific information dependencies; substantive conditional consequences; task-scoped assistance; relation-first communication; comparable priorities; separate evidential and requested-value review. No case-specific rules, empirical superiority or guaranteed compliance claim.
provenance.release_8_0_runtime: Makes a revisable generative structure the shared core for explanation, relational transformation, intervention discovery, prototypes and feedback. Separates independent generation from adversarial exact-output review; display scope no longer disables backend transformation. Reviews model and reachable-outcome increments, not caution or classification. Complete method, archive and state tools preserved byte-for-byte; no empirical superiority or host enforcement claim.
provenance.release_8_0_1_runtime: Preserves the production identity of direct observations, estimates, counterfactuals and assistant-authored drafts. Central new relations must trace to supporting and limiting material, survive a plain-language rewrite and produce a consequence distinct from their strongest alternative. Confounded comparisons open competing consequences instead of ending in a variable list. Review rejects decorative terms, formulas and tables, arbitrary time windows, self-confirming evidence upgrades and unrequested prevention based on invented deterioration. Method, archive and executable support scripts remain unchanged; no general compliance or performance claim.
provenance.release_8_0_2_runtime: Carries each relation's object, question position, time scope, material identity and limits through synthesis and final delivery. Alternatives compete only when they answer the same explanatory question at a compatible scope; different causal locations may still compete for one result. Composite contrasts do not become individual causal effects during compression. Overall trends, path opportunities and subject-level net benefits remain distinct; forecasts, chosen decision deadlines and observation periods use different warrants. User-supplied dates do not justify themselves, and unsupported calendars become event conditions rather than a default choice of the later date. Exact-draft review traces headlines, ranges, summaries and recommendations back to their weakest premises and rejects preventive action created solely by imagined deterioration. Method, archive and executable support scripts remain unchanged; no general compliance or performance claim.
provenance.release_9_0_runtime: Reconstructs execution around outcome dependencies, inspectable work, actual independent expansion, generation-quality review, targeted rework and exact-deliverable review. Prioritizes breadth, depth, relational innovation, information updates and action-supported comparisons; consolidates repetitive caution. check_work.py binds local file versions and review records without assessing semantic quality, authenticating reviewers or enforcing host sending. Complete method, archive and existing state scripts remain byte-for-byte unchanged. No artificial minimum duration, fixed iteration quota, forced novelty or universal advantage claim.
provenance.release_9_1_runtime: Separates explanatory findings from intervention selection while preserving shared facts and prototype feedback. Dialogue owns mixed-request scope, point-first complex change delivery, subsequent action expansion, direct full-plan fulfillment and plain stage-matched continuation. Intervention positions, actions and innovation use uncapped, value-based search with explicit expansion invitations and meaningful candidate retention. Distinguishes necessary evidence, optional neutral recall and unconfirmed assistant-authored drafts. Quality and exact-draft reviews check scope, goals, innovation delivery, source identity, feasible ranking and usable continuation. Complete method, archive, UI and executable tools are unchanged. No numeric search quota, urgency-specific branch, guaranteed novelty, exhaustive search or host-enforcement claim.
provenance.release_9_2_runtime: Separates internal outcome/stage responsibility in runtime from natural user expression in dialogue. Point discovery uses influenceability and value comparisons without mandatory per-point action prototypes; action design handles many-to-many point coverage, overlap and residual gains, and plans compare combinations. Continued generation can deepen, broaden, challenge, recombine, construct or acquire information, retaining both current best choices and independently valuable alternatives. Activates relevant cognitive, attention, meaning and adoption pathways alongside bodily, behavioral, environmental and structural routes. Quality and exact-draft reviews check stage completion, substantive generation and understandable delivery instead of exporting internal checklists. Future forecasts, commitment, validation domain and immediate operations are distinguished. Complete method, archive, UI and executable tools remain unchanged. No fixed iteration quota, exhaustive-search, guaranteed novelty, universal compliance or host-enforcement claim.
provenance.release_9_3_runtime: Connects requested deliverables through actual dependencies while keeping internal work distinct from user expression. Candidates entering current adoption comparison first have feasible effect paths; coupled positions compete before action and plan selection. Positions, directions, operations and plans remain distinct; actions explain mechanisms, meaning and adoption when relevant, without making cognition a universal prerequisite. Single actions, combinations and no added work compete. Review repairs outcome-changing generation and design failures before surface wording; continuation names the actual next work. Alternatives are retained internally and delivered by current value rather than as field templates. The method, archive, UI and executable support tools remain unchanged. Limited development observations do not establish universal effectiveness, guaranteed novelty, exhaustive search or host enforcement.
provenance.release_9_4_runtime: Selects stage-matched public deliverables without discarding deeper internal comparisons. Retains independently useful alternatives, batches already-found content when needed and delivers expansion deltas even when the leading choice is unchanged. Distinguishes found-but-unexpanded from not-yet-searched work. Optional neutral recall visibly supports discovery beyond existing hypotheses without leading memories or blocking progress. Next-work handoff and current-stage expansion remain distinct, brief and scope-aware. Reviews prioritize substantive generation and usable mechanisms over caution wording. The complete method, source archive, UI and executable support tools are unchanged. Development tests do not establish exhaustive search, universal compliance, empirical superiority or host enforcement.
provenance.release_9_5_runtime: Answers direct horizon questions with warranted conditional scales, distinguishes forecasts from planning assumptions, and verifies consequential prior personal constraints before commitment. Actions are compared by target, time of effect and added monitoring burden rather than inherited point order. Public answers are reconstructed from useful relations, including concrete headings; the next-work handoff does not export all subordinate design. Generation and delivery review share those responsibilities. Existing information discovery, uncapped candidate value, incremental expansion and stage distinctions remain. The method, source archive, UI and executable tools are unchanged. Development observations do not establish treatment efficacy, universal quality or exhaustive search.
provenance.release_9_6_runtime: Outcome-first generation with grounded leading explanations, competitive conditional futures, consequence-filtered evidence relations and public expression kept separate. Nine internal leverage search entrances span dynamics, transmission, causal closure, structure/position, mechanism, goals/tendencies, variables/dimensions, paradigms, and local chambers/windows/anomalies. They synthesize method sections 4-7 and are not a relabeling of the unchanged method section 6.3 nine-category table; environmental supply, constraints, selection and feedback remain cross-cutting. Goals and protected values guide multi-layer search and short/long-term action comparisons. Open futures include capability, cost, organizational/product change and real execution interfaces, rather than defaulting to validation. Feedback purposes, side-question task stacks, substantive value reviews and stage-true continuation use existing modules and tools without new fixed forms. The complete method, archived source, UI and executable support scripts remain unchanged. Semantic observations are limited, not a claim of universal superiority or real-world efficacy.
provenance.release_9_7_runtime: Preserves 9.6 outcome-first generation, nine internal search entrances, protected goals, open futures, evidence identity and mainline recovery. Repeated defensive constraints are consolidated into positive generation, information and delivery responsibilities. Expanded candidates feed relationship synthesis, complementary positions, distinct branches and new reachable results. Preferred actions compare goal/time-matched effect paths, applicable evidence, strong feasible alternatives, user conditions, reversibility and risks. Personal problems activate selective value, classification, feedback, window and control reconstruction alongside mature alternatives. Public qualification uses a consequence-of-deletion test; shared limits appear once, known goals carry forward, and continuation follows actual unfinished work without mandatory dual invitations. Reviews repair inference, synthesis and ranking before expression. No new modules, state fields or review rounds. Method, archived source, UI and executable support tools remain unchanged. Private forward outputs and recovery files are excluded; limited observations do not establish universal quality, comparative superiority or real-world efficacy.
provenance.release_9_8_runtime: Activates action authority, strongest feasible route competition, adoption formation and explanation carriers at existing handoffs. Stage-specific information distinguishes decisive gaps from optional discovery without a global question cap. Open futures follow new bottlenecks and different real interfaces; continuation preserves actual search state. No new runtime modules, fields or review rounds. Method, engineering archive, UI and state support remain unchanged. The release validator normalizes inventory paths for Windows. Private diagnostics and behavioral outputs are outside the distribution; observations do not establish long-term efficacy or cross-model stability. Exact-version review reads also use binary mode and consistent Windows descriptor metadata; the review schema and assurance boundaries are unchanged.
provenance.release_9_8_1_runtime: Narrow user-facing language correction over 9.8.0. Concision comes from selection and deduplication rather than clipped words, field-like phrasing, or one-off coined labels. Dialogue and final review require ordinary complete wording while preserving substantive relations, evidence, and action value. Evaluation reads full outputs; keyword scans are not treated as semantic proof. Method, change logic, runtime, UI, state support, and scripts remain unchanged.
provenance.release_9_8_2_runtime: Targeted execution correction over 9.8.1. Future numerical ranges require a basis for each bound while unsupported precision falls back to explicit event or magnitude judgments, not empty uncertainty. External claims are bound to the source that actually supports each product fact, date, number, denominator, and conclusion. Final review rejects unsolicited monitoring or service invitations unless requested or selected as a necessary action. Method, runtime architecture, UI, state support, and scripts remain unchanged.
provenance.release_9_8_3_runtime: Activates existing autonomous generation before answer fixation, calls the concentrated method relation for human change, compares actual independent contributions, and makes information acquisition contingent on decision or discovery value. No new modules, runtime fields, review rounds or executable support code. Private behavior materials are excluded; samples are not cross-model or real-world guarantees. Reopens action comparison when an informed user asks to advance an unfinished goal, with an explicit delivery review at that transition.
